description: EXECUTION DE TRAVAUX ELECTRIQUES ET FOURNITURE DE MATERIELS ELECTRIQUES is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by MAIRIE DES PONTS DE CE. Les prestations concernent les travaux électriques en HTA et BT ainsi que la fourniture de matériels électriques à réaliser sur la commune des Ponts de Cé. Les installations seront réalisées conformément à la législation française, en respectant les normes et DTU en vigueur. Coverage: MAIRIE DES PONTS DE CE. The publisher named on the listing is MAIRIE DES PONTS DE CE. Its keywords include electricite, marches-publics. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF. The listing shows 2025-05-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
